info.title: sbol-db
info.description:
A Postgres-backed data management system for synthetic biology data. It ingests SBOL 3 RDF, upgrades SBOL 2 RDF, and imports GenBank or FASTA into SBOL 3 before projecting designs into a typed relational schema *and* an RDF quad store inside the same Postgres instance. It then exposes the result through five composable query primitives: typed lookup by IRI, bounded graph neighborhood traversal, read-only SPARQL 1.1, nucleotide substring + reverse-complement search, and ontology-aware role expansion.

See [`docs/crate-guide.md`](https://github.com/marpaia/sbol-db/blob/master/docs/crate-guide.md) for an architectural tour.

tags.name: Graphs
tags.description: Import SBOL documents into named graphs and inspect what was stored.

tags.name: Objects
tags.description: Resolve typed SBOL objects by IRI and re-emit them as RDF.

tags.name: Neighborhood
tags.description: Bounded recursive graph traversal across the triplestore.

tags.name: SPARQL
tags.description: Read-only SPARQL 1.1 evaluator (SELECT / ASK / CONSTRUCT / DESCRIBE).

tags.name: Sequences
tags.description: Nucleotide substring + reverse-complement search backed by the k-mer seed index.

tags.name: Ontology
tags.description: Load OBO ontologies (SO, SBO, ...) and resolve transitive `is_a` closure.

tags.name: Jobs
tags.description: Background work queue: enqueue, inspect, and cancel async jobs (e.g. document imports). Workers claim with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, leases auto-renew, retries are exponentially backed off.

tags.name: Meta
tags.description: Liveness, readiness, metrics, OpenAPI schema, and this docs page.

tags.name: SynBioHub v1 Auth
tags.description: SynBioHub-compatible account routes. Bodies accept form-encoded or JSON; responses are Accept-negotiated (a browser gets a redirect and session cookie, an API client gets a machine-readable body). Authenticated calls present the token in the `X-authorization` header.

tags.name: SynBioHub v1 Query
tags.description: SynBioHub-compatible read and search surface. Answers are SPARQL-results JSON, scoped to the caller's authorized graphs resolved from `X-authorization`.

tags.name: SynBioHub v1 Submission
tags.description: SynBioHub-compatible submission and object lifecycle verbs (submit, makePublic, remove, replace, removeCollection, icon). Owner-gated through the facade.

tags.name: SynBioHub v1 Edit
tags.description: SynBioHub-compatible field edits: mutable text fields, citations, and the generic edit/add/remove of a field plus collection membership. Owner-gated.

tags.name: SynBioHub v1 Permissions
tags.description: SynBioHub-compatible object sharing: grant and revoke another account's view access. Owner-gated.

tags.name: SynBioHub v1 Downloads
tags.description: SynBioHub-compatible closure downloads in each exchange format (SBOL, GenBank, FASTA, GFF3, OMEX, summary). ACL-scoped.

tags.name: SynBioHub v1 Attachments
tags.description: SynBioHub-compatible attachment upload (file or external URL) and blob download.

tags.name: SynBioHub v1 Admin
tags.description: SynBioHub-compatible admin surface. Every route requires an authenticated administrator (`X-authorization`); a non-admin or anonymous caller gets 403.

tags.name: SynBioHub v1 Plugins
tags.description: SynBioHub-compatible plugin proxying and the temp-file / async-stream handoffs.

tags.name: SynBioHub v1 SPARQL
tags.description: Virtuoso-protocol authenticated SPARQL query and Graph Store CRUD endpoints, behind HTTP Basic auth. SynBioHub points its `sparql-graph-crud-auth/` writes here.

get.description: Static liveness probe. Returns `ok` if the process is running; does not touch Postgres. Wire this to Kubernetes `livenessProbe`.
Issues a short-timeout `SELECT 1` against the connection pool. Returns 200 when Postgres is reachable, 503 otherwise. Wire this to Kubernetes `readinessProbe`.

Prometheus text-format exposition of HTTP request counters/histograms (keyed by templated route), `sbol_db_pool_connections` gauges, and a `sbol_db_build_info` label gauge. Intended for in-cluster scraping; not part of the public query API.

post.summary: Import a design document into a named graph
post.description: Parses the request body as SBOL 3 RDF, SBOL 2 RDF, GenBank, or FASTA in the format derived from the `format` query parameter or the `Content-Type` header. Non-SBOL-3 inputs are converted to SBOL 3, then persisted inside one transaction (objects + triples + typed projections + validation) and returned as an import report.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Namespace IRI for formats that need one. SBOL 2 uses it only as an upgrade fallback; GenBank and FASTA use it for emitted SBOL 3 object identities.

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: 0 fails on an existing `document_iri` (default), 1 replaces that graph, 2 merges into it. Replace and merge require `document_iri`.

delete.summary: Delete a graph by its document IRI
delete.description: Resolves the graph named by `document_iri` and deletes it at graph granularity: its triples, derived objects, and registry row.

delete.summary: Delete a graph by its surrogate id
delete.description: Deletes one document graph by its surrogate id at graph granularity: its triples, derived objects, and registry row.

post.description: Imports up to 100 graphs inside one transaction. **Either every graph commits or none do**. If any graph fails to parse or persist, the entire batch is rolled back and the first error is returned unchanged. Per-graph validation runs and projection events are still recorded individually, but they share the outer transaction's atomicity.

get.summary: Resolve a stored SBOL object by IRI

get.description: Lists stored objects in lexicographic IRI order with a keyset cursor. Use this for whole-corpus dumps; per-page size capped at 5000. Pass the response's `next_cursor` as `after` on the next call until `next_cursor` is null.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Cursor: last `iri` from the prior page.

200.description: Page of matching objects plus a cursor for the next page (null when exhausted).

post.summary: Bulk resolution of objects by IRI
post.description: Batched form of `GET /objects?iri=…`. Resolves up to 1000 IRIs in a single round trip via `WHERE iri = ANY(...)`. The response separates the IRIs that resolved (`found`) from those that did not (`missing`).

get.summary: Re-emit an object subgraph as RDF

get.description: Walks the graph outward from `iri` under explicit depth, direction, and predicate-allowlist bounds. Returns visited nodes and edges as JSON. See [`docs/neighborhood.md`](https://github.com/marpaia/sbol-db/blob/master/docs/neighborhood.md).

200.description: Visited subgraph in the chosen format.

get.description: Read-only SPARQL endpoint. Update queries are rejected. The result format defaults to `application/sparql-results+json` for SELECT / ASK and `text/turtle` for CONSTRUCT / DESCRIBE; override via `Accept` header or the `format` query parameter.

parameters.name: query
parameters.example: PREFIX sbol: <http://sbols.org/v3#> SELECT ?s WHERE { ?s a sbol:Component } LIMIT 10

get.description: Exact-match search over every indexed nucleotide `sbol:Sequence`. The k-mer seed index covers queries ≥ 8 bp; shorter patterns fall back to an `ILIKE` candidate scan. See [`docs/sequences.md`](https://github.com/marpaia/sbol-db/blob/master/docs/sequences.md).

200.description: Hits sorted by sequence then position.

post.description: Runs the GET form for each pattern in the request body. Capped at 256 patterns per call. The response preserves input order with one `BatchSequenceMatch` entry per pattern.

post.summary: Fetch an OBO ontology and load it
post.description: Recognised prefixes (`so`, `sbo`) resolve to OBO Foundry defaults; for any other prefix supply `url` (and optionally `name`). The terms, aliases, and transitive `is_a` closure are materialised in one transaction. Reload replaces the previous version atomically.

get.summary: Get an ontology term by IRI or CURIE
Page through every term in a loaded ontology
get.description: Returns the terms belonging to `prefix`, sorted by curie, optionally filtered by a case-insensitive substring match against either the curie or the name. The response includes the total match count so clients can render pagination without a second round-trip.

Returns the canonical term plus every descendant under it. Accepts the canonical OBO Foundry IRI (`http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/SO_0000167`), the identifiers.org form, or a bare CURIE (`SO:0000167`).

post.description: Inserts a row in `sbol_jobs`. If `idempotency_key` is set and a non-terminal or succeeded job already exists for the same `(kind, idempotency_key)` pair, the existing job is returned with `deduplicated: true` rather than re-queued.

200.description: The job row, plus a flag indicating whether it was deduplicated against an existing entry.

get.description: Filters compose with AND. The default `limit` is 100; values above 1000 are clamped. Results are ordered most-recent-first.

get.summary: Per-attempt audit log for a job
get.description: Returns each row in `sbol_job_attempts` for the given job, newest first. Useful for inspecting a failed job's retry history, including the worker that ran each attempt and its error message. Returns 404 when the job id does not exist; returns 200 with an empty array when the job exists but has not yet been dequeued.

get.summary: Structured log lines for a job
get.description: Returns the log lines a job's handler emitted, oldest first, keyset-paginated by `after_id`. Returns 404 when the job id does not exist.

parameters.name: after_id
parameters.description: Cursor: last log `id` from the prior page.

post.summary: Cancel a queued or running job
post.description: Idempotent: transitions `queued` or `running` jobs to `cancelled` and returns `{ cancelled: true }`. Terminal jobs (succeeded / failed / dead / already cancelled) are left alone and return `{ cancelled: false }`.

200.description: Whether this call transitioned the job.

get.summary: Compact health + traffic snapshot for the lab observability page
get.description: Returns process health, the API + worker pool capacity, job queue depth + oldest-queued age, recent failure counts, and a rolling 10-minute traffic window (request rate, latency quantiles, error counts).

Reports the running engine (`postgres`/`sqlite`/`rocksdb`), its display name, and capability flags (sql_console, relational_schema, maintenance, slow_query_stats, activity_and_locks). The lab UI fetches this once and gates features on it.
Relational engines only (Postgres, SQLite). 501 on a key-value backend.
Relational engines only (Postgres, SQLite). 501 on a key-value backend.

200.description: Per-table stats (rows, total and index bytes, and on Postgres dead-tuple and vacuum metadata).

get.description: Relational engines only (Postgres, SQLite). 501 on a key-value backend.

200.description: Index stats; idx_scan is reported on Postgres.

get.description: Postgres only (from pg_stat_activity). Empty on other backends.

200.description: Per-pid live state, excluding the requester's own backend.

get.description: Postgres only (from pg_locks). Empty on other backends.

get.summary: Schema introspection for a single table
get.description: Columns (name, column_type, nullability, default, comment, primary-key flag) plus outgoing and incoming foreign-key references. Relational engines only. Returns 404 when the relation does not exist.

200.description: Full schema metadata for the requested table.

get.summary: Top slow queries (Postgres, if pg_stat_statements is installed)
get.description: Returns `{ status: "not_installed", setup_hint }` when the extension isn't present; otherwise `{ status: "installed", rows }`.

post.description: Refreshes planner statistics and reclaims space (SQLite VACUUM/ANALYZE, Postgres ANALYZE). Relational engines only.

200.description: `{ ok: true }` when the maintenance ran.

get.description: RocksDB only. Total size, estimated keys, pending compaction bytes, running compactions, and per-column-family and per-level breakdowns. 501 on other backends.

200.description: Column families, levels, and compaction state.

post.description: RocksDB only. Compacts every column family; can be slow on a large store. 501 on other backends.

get.summary: Recent job history across all queues

post.summary: Authenticate and mint a session token
post.description: Verifies credentials and issues an API token. An API client gets the bare token as `text/plain`; a browser gets a session cookie and a 302 to `next`.

200.description: Authenticated. The token as a `text/plain` body.

302.description: Browser flow: session cookie set and redirect to `next`.

post.description: Revokes the token in `X-authorization`. A browser additionally has its session cookie cleared and is redirected home.

302.description: Browser flow: session cookie cleared and redirect home.

post.description: Creates a member account when public signup is enabled, otherwise 403. New accounts are members, not admins or curators.
Mints a single-use reset link and enqueues its delivery email. The response is identical whether or not the address is registered, so it does not leak account existence.

post.summary: Consume a reset link and set a new password
post.description: Consumes the reset link from `/resetPassword` and stores the new password hash. An unrecognized or already-used link is a 400.

get.description: A `q` parameter routes to the native object-text search; its absence ranks the whole in-scope corpus through the SynBioHub relevance path.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text query. When present, the native object-text search answers.

get.summary: Search using the classic path grammar
get.description: The SynBioHub search grammar as a path segment, e.g. `/search/objectType=Component&<so:0000167>plasmid`. Free text ranks over the index; a purely faceted query runs as accelerated SPARQL. A `sequence=`/`globalsequence=`/`exactsequence=` facet aligns as a sequence search.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The classic search grammar (may contain slashes).

parameters.name: graph
parameters.description: The graph IRI to read or write.

parameters.description: Target the default graph instead of a named one.

NeighborhoodPredicates.name: predicates
NeighborhoodPredicates.description: Comma-separated predicate IRIs (axum's default query parser does not support repeated keys).

NeighborhoodLiterals.name: literals
NeighborhoodLiterals.description: Include literal-position edges in the result (does not affect the traversal frontier).

XAuthorization.name: X-authorization
XAuthorization.description: SynBioHub session token. Present it to act as the authenticated account; omit it for anonymous access to public objects.

SbhAccept.name: Accept
SbhAccept.description: When it includes `text/html` the response is the browser flow (redirect plus session cookie); otherwise an API-client body is returned.

SbhField.name: field
SbhField.description: The property to edit, add to, or remove from.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist.

SparqlResult.description: Serialized SPARQL result. The content type matches the format the engine produced.

SparqlResultsJson.description: SPARQL 1.1 Query Results JSON: a `head.vars` list and a `results.bindings` array.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is required and none was presented, or the credentials were rejected.

Forbidden.description: The caller is authenticated but not permitted (e.g. not the owner, or not an administrator).

SbhFormOrJson.description: Form-encoded (classic SynBioHub) or JSON (API clients). The `Content-Type` selects the parser.

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic auth for the Virtuoso-protocol SPARQL endpoints. Defaults to `dba`/`dba` to match Virtuoso; configurable, and skippable behind a trusted proxy.

content_hash.description: Content hash of the stored serialization, as a byte array.

fields.description: Structured context attached to the line.

body.description: Payload in the format named by `format`.

next_cursor.description: IRI to pass as `after` on the next call; absent or null when the listing is exhausted.

prefix.description: Short prefix used as the row key (e.g. `so`, `sbo`).

url.description: Required for prefixes without a built-in default.

name.description: Display name. Defaults to the prefix when omitted.

kind.description: Handler name. Built-in handlers include `import_document`, `import_remote_document`, and `import_synbiohub_collection`.

result.description: Handler-specific JSON result; populated after success.

error.description: Last error message; populated after failure.

available_at.description: Earliest time the job is eligible for dequeue (used by retry backoff).

leased_by.description: Worker id holding the lease while `status = running`.

idempotency_key.description: When set, deduplicates against any non-terminal or succeeded job with the same `(kind, idempotency_key)`.

finished_at.description: Null while the attempt is still in-flight.

deduplicated.description: True when an existing job was returned instead of inserting a new one.
